meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为短篇网文市场分析师，按流程扫榜分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的热门短篇数据，提取情绪类型、题材热点、篇幅、开头模式等，输出带风口预警和选题建议的扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-short-scan”“/短篇扫榜”等命令，或问“短篇什么火”等短篇排行问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的热门短篇
say.note: 进入知乎盐言故事扫榜流程

say.text: 看看七猫短篇最近什么题材火
say.note: 按七猫平台做扫榜分析

say.text: 短篇什么火？给我一份扫榜报告
say.note: 生成带风口预警的完整报告

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a short-story market analyst. It scans hot short stories on platforms like Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, and Dianzhong, extracts emotion types, topic hotspots, word counts, opening patterns, etc., and outputs a report with trend alerts and topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say commands like "/story-short-scan" or "/短篇扫榜", or ask questions like "短篇什么火" (what short stories are trending).

say_en.text: Scan the hot short stories on Zhihu Yanyan for me.
say_en.note: Enters the Zhihu Yanyan scanning flow.

say_en.text: What genres are trending on Qimao short stories?
say_en.note: Runs a topic scan for Qimao.

say_en.text: What short stories are hot? Give me a report.
say_en.note: Generates a full report with trend alerts.
